outcome: Gestational age- and sex-adjusted birth weight (Z-scores)
cohort: Women who had singleton deliveries after vitrified-warmed single blastocyst embryo transfers between 2013 and 2020
finding: The embryo culture medium (Irvine CSC vs Vitrolife G5(TM) PLUS) did not affect birth outcomes or obstetric complications in vitrified-warmed single blastocyst transfer cycles.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the two groups.
